HURRICANE = re.compile(r"\bGOLD\s+(BUY|SELL)\s+SETUP\b", re.I)

HURRICANE_ZONE = re.compile(
    r"\bGold\s+(?:Buy|Sell)\s+Zone\s*(\d{4,}(?:\.\d+)?)(?:\s*[-–]\s*(\d{4,}(?:\.\d+)?))?",
    re.I,
)

ALLIANCE = re.compile(
    r"\bXAUUSD\s+(BUY|SELL)\s*(LIMIT\s*)?(\d{4,}(?:\.\d+)?)"
    r"(?:\s*[-–]\s*(\d{4,}(?:\.\d+)?))?",
    re.I,
)

STOP = re.compile(r"\bSL\s*:?\s*(\d{4,}(?:\.\d+)?)", re.I)

TARGET = re.compile(r"^\s*TP\s*\d*\s*:?\s*(\d{4,}(?:\.\d+)?)", re.I | re.M)

HIT_TP = re.compile(r"\b(?:HIT\s+TP\s*([1-9])|TP\s*([1-9])\s+HIT)\b", re.I)

HIT_SL = re.compile(r"\b(?:HIT\s+SL|SL\s+HIT)\b", re.I)

def message_text(msg: dict) -> str:
    value = msg.get('text', '')
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return ''.join(part if isinstance(part, str) else str(part.get('text', ''))
                       for part in value)
    return ''

def parse_signal(msg: dict, name: str) -> dict | None:
    raw = message_text(msg)
    if HURRICANE.search(raw):
        match = HURRICANE.search(raw)
        zone_match = HURRICANE_ZONE.search(raw)
        if not zone_match:
            return None
        direction = match.group(1).upper()
        zone = [float(zone_match.group(1)), float(zone_match.group(2) or zone_match.group(1))]
        kind = 'zone'
    else:
        match = ALLIANCE.search(raw)
        if not match:
            return None
        direction = match.group(1).upper()
        zone = [float(match.group(3)), float(match.group(4) or match.group(3))]
        kind = 'pending_limit' if match.group(2) else 'zone_or_market'

    stop_match = STOP.search(raw)
    stop = float(stop_match.group(1)) if stop_match else None
    targets = [float(x) for x in TARGET.findall(raw)]
    low, high = min(zone), max(zone)
    issues = []
    if stop is None:
        issues.append('Missing full stop-loss price')
    elif direction == 'BUY' and not stop < low:
        issues.append('BUY stop loss is not below the entry zone')
    elif direction == 'SELL' and not stop > high:
        issues.append('SELL stop loss is not above the entry zone')

    if not targets:
        issues.append('No numeric take-profit levels')
    else:
        # A 100-point jump in an otherwise 5-to-10-point TP ladder is not safe to trade.
        gaps = [abs(b - a) for a, b in zip(targets, targets[1:])]
        if len(gaps) >= 2 and min(gaps) > 0 and max(gaps) > 5 * min(gaps):
            issues.append('Unusually large gap between take-profit targets: possible typo')
    if targets and direction == 'BUY':
        if targets[0] <= high:
            issues.append('BUY first target is not above the entry zone')
        if any(later <= earlier for earlier, later in zip(targets, targets[1:])):
            issues.append('BUY target ladder not strictly increasing: possible typo')
    elif targets:
        if targets[0] >= low:
            issues.append('SELL first target is not below the entry zone')
        if any(later >= earlier for earlier, later in zip(targets, targets[1:])):
            issues.append('SELL target ladder not strictly decreasing: possible typo')

    is_update = 'updated' in raw.lower() or 'zone updated' in raw.lower()
    return {
        'chat_name': name,
        'message_id': msg['id'],
        'date': msg.get('date'),
        'edited_at': msg.get('edited'),
        'reply_to_message_id': msg.get('reply_to_message_id'),
        'direction': direction,
        'entry_zone_original_order': zone,
        'entry_zone_low': low,
        'entry_zone_high': high,
        'entry_type': kind,
        'stop_loss': stop,
        'take_profits': targets,
        'tp4_hold': bool(re.search(r'\bTP4\s*:\s*Hold\b', raw, re.I)),
        'is_marked_revision': is_update,
        'validation_issues': issues,
        'message_text': raw,
        'followups': [],
        'reported_tp_milestones': [],
        'reported_stop_hit': False,
        'reported_invalidated': False,
    }
